scope: Three deliberately selected closed historical issues from Pallets repositories. Not a representative sample or production accuracy benchmark.

cases.selection_reason: Contains runnable example, 3.1.1/3.1.2 behavior comparison, versions and tracebacks; comments add historical resolution plans and user experiments.
review_checks: Preserve the reported regression, versions and timing of teardown calls; do not re-request information already visible.
Attribute reproduction, workarounds and the 3.2 fix plan to their authors; do not claim code execution or a verified released fix.
Keep author suggestions separate from maintainer guidance and acknowledge closed status.
Use retrieved catalog labels and applicable templates conservatively; optional extra diagnostics do not prove essential information is absent.

cases.selection_reason: Shows versions and partial client/endpoint snippets but no complete Flask-only application; a maintainer requests a minimal example and the reporter links an unverified cross-repository claim.
review_checks: Identify the missing complete minimal application or route/integration details without asking again for the supplied Python and Flask versions.
Treat the reporter's Werkzeug issue link as an attributed claim; the current tools cannot read arbitrary cross-repository issues.
Do not manufacture confirmed root causes or affirmative differences from missing details.
Ask focused triage questions; any information-needed label must exist in the loaded catalog and satisfy its description.

cases.selection_reason: Requests two named Cache-Control extensions and explains CDN use cases; no crash or bug reproduction is alleged.
review_checks: Recognize a feature request for stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error in ResponseCacheControl.
Do not demand bug-only fields or repeat already supplied feature purpose and use cases.
Closed status alone does not establish implemented behavior, a release version or a confirmed resolution.
Ground comparisons and labels in retrieved evidence and preserve template required-state uncertainty.
